segments.title: Cold Open & Workout Thread Setup
segments.notes: Pepito signs on from the patio, creates a Discord thread for viewer workout suggestions, and prepares the stream layout.

segments.title: Core-gasm Workout Attempt
segments.notes: Pepito follows a Women's Health 'cougar-gasm' routine; immediate abdominal cramping forces him to abort and crawl to recovery.

segments.title: Richard Simmons & Dance Cardio
segments.notes: Pepito tries a 20-minute Richard Simmons blast-off and a 10-minute brat dance workout, unable to keep pace with either.

segments.title: Pelvic Floor & Breakdancing Tutorials
segments.notes: Pepito works through pelvic-floor mobility drills that escalate into breakdance footwork breakdowns with Kendall coaching from off-camera.

segments.title: Extended Breakdance Practice
segments.notes: Pepito drills threading kicks, frog transitions, and helicopter moves on cardboard, repeatedly pausing to analyze the instructor's kinetics.

segments.title: Anime Exercises & Strength Challenges
segments.notes: Pepito attempts 'How to Dance Like Reagan' and anime-ranked calisthenics (clapping push-ups, weighted push-ups, planche progressions), failing the advanced tiers.

segments.title: Hot Dog String Challenge
segments.notes: Sub-goal warm-down: Pepito tethers a hot dog to string and whips it into his mouth; succeeds on second attempt after splitting the first.

segments.title: Sign-Off & Raid
segments.notes: Pepito confirms the hot dog catch, thanks subscribers, and raids 'statics later' while Kendall performs a backflip ritual.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Hosted a solo late-night workout special from the patio, cycling through viewer-suggested routines and completing the sub-goal hot dog string challenge.

lore_notes.fact: Pepito hosted a 101-minute solo workout broadcast from the patio, marking the first full-length fitness special led by the executive producer.
Kendelle declined to participate in the 'core-gasm' abdominal routine, citing visible distress at the proposition.
Pepito suffered an immediate abdominal cramp/spasm during the first plank sequence, requiring a floor recovery crawl.
The sub-goal hot dog string challenge was completed on the second attempt after the first hot dog split mid-swing.
Broadcast concluded with a raid to 'statics later' while Kendall performed a backflip and 'secret rituals' on camera.

episode_summary: Executive producer Pepito anchored a solo late-night fitness special from the patio, subjecting himself to a viewer-curated gauntlet of core-gasm ab work, Richard Simmons cardio, pelvic-floor breakdance drills, and anime-ranked calisthenics. The broadcast ended with the sub-goal hot dog string challenge — a tethered hot dog whipped into Pepito's mouth on the second try — before a raid to 'statics later' accompanied by Kendall's backflip finale.
